claims.claim: Read slot contracts and implementation manifests only during capability maintenance.
claims.trigger: Deciding whether to read CONTRACT.md or MODULE.md outside capability maintenance
claims.exceptions: May describe intended loading rather than impose an absolute prohibition on incidental reading. Does not prohibit ordinary reading of imported planning decisions.
claims.enforcement_effect: Possible procedural loading restriction; no runtime gate demonstrated.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Primary calls loading information implementation/non-normative because no product duty; this does not decide whether it restricts agent loading.
Not auto-loaded differs from never read outside maintenance; source quotation attached to ownership rule may incorporate loading but its action does not express that restriction.
Cardinality and selected facets do not alone restrict on-demand reading. No separate loading prohibition found in candidate records inspected.

claims.comparison_reason: Temporal loading restriction is a plausible atom distinct from default non-auto-loading; declarative metadata interpretation and replica evidence linkage keep novelty unresolved.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Agent leaves contracts out of automatic context but voluntarily reads a MODULE.md for ordinary product implementation without doing capability maintenance. Not-auto-loaded is satisfied; literal only-during reading rule would not be.
claims.open_question: Is read only during capability maintenance a binding restriction or merely a description of the loading model already registered by replica?
claims.next_evidence_strategy: Family6 inspect MAP, capability headers and maintenance workflow; family5 test incidental read vs explicit load duty.
